rationale_text: Case 10079_1000079: a 1.24 cc lesion in the transition zone is mildly hypointense/indeterminate on T2W (z=-0.25 relative to same-zone background tissue) with round to oval, more circumscribed (sphericity=0.68) margins. A substantial portion of the lesion falls outside the automated whole-gland segmentation, suggestive of extraprostatic extension (note: the gland mask is AI-derived and not verified at the capsule boundary, so this may partly reflect gland-segmentation imprecision rather than confirmed extension). These measurements are consistent with PI-RADS category 2.
